details.title: About your trial
details.body: The trial lets you try everything with a limited number of students.
details.kept: Everything you add now is kept when you continue.

idle.title: Your school is paused
idle.body: Your account was paused because no student was added. Your data is safe. Contact us to reopen it.

ended.title: Your trial has ended
ended.body: Your data is safe. You can download a copy, or contact us to continue.
ended.exportFailed: We could not prepare the file. Try again.

seatLimit.title: Student limit reached
seatLimit.body: You have {{used}} of {{limit}} students. {{requested}} more will not fit.
seatLimit.hint: Contact us to add more students.
